spans.s:
भूप m. (-पः) A sovereign, a prince, a king.
 E. भू the earth, पा to che-
rish, aff. क ।

भूपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign.
 E. भू the earth, and पति master.

भूपद m. (-दः) A tree.
 f. (-दी) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)
E. भू the earth, and पद foot, root.

भूपरिधि m. (-धिः)
 1. The equinoctial line.
 2. The circumference of the
earth.
 E. भू and परिधि a circle.

भूपाल m. (-लः) A king, a sovereign.
 E. भू the earth, and पाल who cherishes.

भूपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA.
 E. भू the earth, and पुत्त्री a
daughter; being turned up out of the soil by a plough.
